entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: A plane of dichotomy: a lush river valley and glorious city ringed by endless scorching desert, ruled by animal-headed gods and a God-Pharaoh.

entities.name: The God-Pharaoh
entities.description: The wise and benevolent ruler of Amonkhet who promises the people a perfect afterlife, secretly Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: A malevolent dragon planeswalker whose schemes reach far beyond Amonkhet, secretly posing as its God-Pharaoh.

entities.name: The Gods of Amonkhet
entities.description: Animal-headed gods who walk among the people, each overseeing one of the five trials to the afterlife.

entities.name: The Five Trials
entities.description: Trials on the path to the afterlife, established by the God-Pharaoh to purify and perfect the people; each cultivates an aspect of mortal perfection.

events.summary: The people train their bodies and minds and eagerly anticipate being permitted to die in combat.
events.quote: Yet they eagerly anticipate the time when they will be permitted to die in combat and leave this world behind.

events.summary: Each god oversees one of the five trials and instructs the initiates preparing to face it.
events.quote: Each god oversees one of the five trials and instructs the initiates who are preparing to face the trial

events.summary: The benevolent God-Pharaoh is revealed to be Nicol Bolas.
events.quote: is actually Nicol Bolas, the malevolent dragon Planeswalker whose schemes reach far beyond this plane.

relations.note: The God-Pharaoh is actually Nicol Bolas.
relations.quote: is actually Nicol Bolas, the malevolent dragon Planeswalker whose schemes reach far beyond this plane.

relations.note: The gods are custodians of the path established by the God-Pharaoh.
relations.quote: The gods are custodians of the path to the afterlife, established by the God-Pharaoh
